title: Turn meeting notes into a clear follow-up
summary: A short, reviewable way to turn your own meeting notes into a useful follow-up.
author: Example author
seoTitle: Turn meeting notes into a clear follow-up
seoDescription: Organize supplied meeting notes, check the details, and prepare a clear follow-up for review.

content.text: Start with notes from a meeting you attended. Use only the details you can verify, and decide who needs the follow-up.
Group the notes into decisions, open questions, and next steps. Check the owner and date for each action. Leave missing details as questions rather than guessing.
Read the draft against your original notes. Confirm names, commitments, and recipients before sharing it.
